description: Satellite detected water extent (98 event data sets, United Nations Satellite Centre, on HDX) is a series of data sets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). UNOSAT code: TC20220124MOZ This map illustrates satellite-detected surface waters in Zambezia Province, Mozambique as observed from a Sentinel-1 image acquired on 28 January 2021 at 05:00 local time and using an automated analysis with Artificial Intelligence based methods. Within the analyzed area of about 44,000 km2, about 860 km2 of lands appear to be flooded. Coverage: Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Ghana, Kenya, Libya, Madagascar and 9 more. The portal lists 98 near-identical data sets in this series (one per event, year, area or country), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are cyclones-hurricanes-typhoons, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEODATABASE, SHP. The portal shows 2026-07-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
